data.title: China XLX Reports Successful Commissioning of Xinjiang Project Phase I
data.description:
An update from China XLX Fertiliser Ltd. ( (HK:1866) ) is now available.

China XLX Fertiliser Ltd. said Phase I of its Xinjiang Zhundong Base, comprising high-efficiency fertiliser facilities, had been successfully commissioned. The base is located in the Zhundong Economic and Technological Development Zone in Xinjiang.

data.title: Nan Nan Resources Signals Preliminary Interim Profit Turnaround
data.description:
An update from Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited ( (HK:1229) ) is now available.

Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited said a preliminary review of unaudited management accounts indicates the Group is expected to move from an approximately HK$3.44 million loss for the six months ended 30 September 2025 to not less than approximately HK$45 million profit for the six months ended 30 September 2026. Final figures remain subject to accounting adjustments, and the interim results have not been audited or reviewed.

The expected change was mainly attributable to an approximately HK$52.76 million fair-value gain on the Company’s HK$200 million zero-coupon convertible bond, a HK$6.39 million decrease in selling and distribution expenses, and a HK$15.56 million increase in administrative and other operating expenses. Excluding the bond fair-value change, the Group expects to record a loss of not more than approximately HK$7.76 million, with the bond valuation movement mainly linked to changes in the Company’s stock price.

data.title: MTT Group Expects Six-Month Loss of About HK$23.7 Million
data.description:
MTT Group Holdings Limited ( (HK:2350) ) has shared an update.

MTT Group Holdings operates distribution and system integration solutions businesses; the release does not specify its primary products or market focus. Based on a preliminary assessment, the Group expects a loss of approximately HK$23.7 million for the six months ended 30 September 2026, compared with approximately HK$14.5 million a year earlier.

Gross profit is expected to have fallen to approximately HK$18.0 million from HK$24.1 million as intense market competition affected both segments, while about HK$9.2 million in research and development expenses were incurred, versus nil in the corresponding period. A net reversal of expected credit loss impairments of about HK$1.1 million, compared with net impairment losses of HK$2.7 million previously, partly offset these factors; the figures remain unaudited and may change before interim results are finalised.

data.title: Yunfeng Reallocates HK$350 Million of Proceeds to Repay Shareholder Loan
data.description:
Yunfeng Financial Group Limited ( (HK:0376) ) has provided an announcement.

Yunfeng Financial Group said development and capital deployment for its virtual asset-related business had been slower than originally anticipated, citing changing market conditions, an evolving regulatory framework and time needed to assess commercial viability and implementation requirements. The board therefore approved reallocating HK$350.0 million of the HK$1,152.8 million net proceeds from a September 2025 top-up placing, originally earmarked for that business, to repay shareholder-loan principal.

The repayment will reduce the loan’s outstanding principal from HK$1,641.08 million to HK$1,291.08 million. The company said reducing interest-bearing debt offers a more immediate and quantifiable financial benefit than retaining substantial funds for investments that may not materialise, amid prevailing borrowing costs and uncertainty over future interest rates.

data.title: Yidu Tech Reports RMB61.3 Million Interim Profit After Year-Earlier Loss
data.description:
The latest update is out from Yidu Tech, Inc. ( (HK:2158) ).

Yidu Tech is a medical AI and data-intelligence company serving healthcare, pharmaceuticals, insurance and patients. Its technology system centers on the YiduCore “AI Medical Brain,” with healthcare large-model development, the EYWA 6.0 data-intelligence hub and medical intelligent agents among its reported capabilities.

For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue increased 5.3% year on year to RMB377.0 million, while gross profit fell 4.1% to RMB128.554 million. Operating profit was RMB63.298 million and profit for the period was RMB61.311 million, compared with losses of RMB15.719 million and RMB15.760 million, respectively, in the year-earlier period.

At the end of the reporting period, cash and cash equivalents, term deposits, pledged bank deposits, restricted bank balance and deposits totaled RMB2,162.3 million. The Group reported cost-structure optimization and improved synergy efficiency across business segments, while the Board did not recommend an interim dividend.

During the period, YiduCore development continued, EYWA 6.0 was released and medical intelligent agents moved into scaled deployment. The Group also continued training and iterating healthcare-domain large models and deploying solutions across healthcare, pharmaceuticals, insurance and patients.

data.title: Sunmi Announces Commercial Physical AI Positioning
data.description:
Shanghai Sunmi Technology Co. Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6810) ) has provided an announcement.

In a voluntary announcement, Sunmi said that after ten years of development, it now positions itself as a “Commercial Physical AI” company rather than a conventional provider of commercial POS terminals or payment devices. It also updated its mission and vision around Business 4.0 and Commercial Physical AI.

Sunmi defines Business 4.0 as using AI to drive intelligent offline equipment, process automation and business decision-making, enabling precise matching of demand-side and supply-side data. The company describes AI as extending from the digital world into physical commerce and outlines its role as a Commercial Physical AI provider.

data.title: Four Seas Mercantile Accepts Ten-Year Premises Lease Offer
data.description:
Four Seas Mercantile Holdings Limited ( (HK:0374) ) has shared an update.

An indirect wholly owned subsidiary accepted the lessor’s offer on 20 November 2026 to rent premises for 10 years, with a stated commencement date of 15 February 2027 or another date specified by the lessor, and an option to renew for a further five years subject to approval. The accepted offer forms a legally binding contract until superseded by the lease, and the subsidiary must execute the lease and admission application within one month after receiving the relevant documents.

Under HKFRS 16, the Group will recognise a right-of-use asset with an unaudited value estimated at approximately HK$377 million, subject to final audit. Because the applicable percentage ratios exceed 25% but remain below 100%, the transaction is classified as a major transaction under the Listing Rules; written approval from shareholders holding approximately 56.81% of the company was accepted in lieu of a general meeting.
